verified.name: 1X Technologies
verified.description: Norwegian-American robotics company developing general-purpose humanoid robots for home and industrial environments. The company manufactures bipedal robots (NEO and EVE models) and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California with manufacturing operations in Hayward and Moss, Norway.
verified.notes: Company was originally founded as Halodi Robotics in 2014 and rebranded to 1X Technologies in 2022. Series A2 funding of $23.5M raised in March 2023 (led by OpenAI Startup Fund). Series B funding of $100M raised in January 2024 (led by EQT Ventures). Total verified raised is $123.5M ($23.5M + $100M). Sources [0] and [1] describe a different company (1X Technologies LLC, a wire and cable distributor founded in 2015 based in Sheridan, WY) and are not applicable to the robotics company.
